beats.say: Did a massive collision with a planet called Theia create our Moon?
Reginald Daly first suggested this giant impact idea back in 1946.
Scientists say a Mars sized body named Theia slammed into the early Earth about 4.5 billion years ago.
The impact threw out huge debris that later clumped together to become the Moon we see today.
Because Theia’s iron core merged with Earth’s, the Moon ended up with a small iron core and is low in volatile substances.
That single cosmic crash explains why our night sky looks the way it does, a Moon born from fire and rock.

meta.title: Moon's origin: giant impact 🌕
meta.summary: The giant impact hypothesis says a Mars sized protoplanet called Theia collided with early Earth about 4.5 billion years ago, creating debris that formed the Moon we see today.
meta.comment: What do you think about the giant impact that formed our Moon?
facts: Reginald Daly first proposed the giant impact hypothesis in 1946.
The impact occurred approximately 4.5 billion years ago.
The impactor was a Mars sized protoplanet called Theia.
Proto Earth collided with Theia in a massive impact event.
Debris ejected from the impact event later re accreted to form the Moon.
The impactor core likely fused with the Earth core.
This explains why the Moon has a relatively small iron core.
The Moon is depleted in volatile substances compared to Earth.
The giant impact hypothesis is currently the favoured hypothesis for lunar formation.

es.title: Origen de la Luna: gran impacto 🌕
es.summary: La hipótesis del gran impacto sugiere que un protoplaneta del tamaño de Marte llamado Theia chocó con la Tierra primitiva hace unos 4.500 millones de años, creando escombros que formaron la Luna que vemos hoy.

pt.title: Origem da Lua: grande impacto 🌕
pt.summary: A hipótese do grande impacto diz que um protoplaneta do tamanho de Marte chamado Theia colidiu com a Terra primitiva há cerca de 4,5 bilhões de anos, criando detritos que formaram a Lua que vemos hoje.

hi.title: चंद्रमा की उत्पत्ति: विशाल प्रभाव 🌕
hi.summary: विशाल प्रभाव परिकल्पना के अनुसार मंगल के आकार का एक प्रोटोप्लैनेट जिसे Theia कहा जाता है, लगभग 4.5 अरब साल पहले शुरुआती पृथ्वी से टकराया था, जिससे मलबा बना और आज का चंद्रमा तैयार हुआ।
